criteria.criterion: A package `internal/runs` resolves a brief (path or name) to its run id and collects every run folder that belongs to it (shell-loop by loop.log planning/resuming with ANSI stripped, vloop by run id folder)
criteria.evidence: runs.go RunID/BriefPath/logOwns/shellFolders/vloopFolders; TestShellLoopFolders covers other-brief, resuming, resuming B1-xyz (rejected), no-log folders

criteria.criterion: Reads sessions, iterations and verdicts into one model; a session's task comes from the iteration it names
criteria.evidence: readFolder/readSession/readIterations/readVerdict handle both shell-loop and v1 shapes; taskOf map from iterations; TestShellLoopSessionsIterationsVerdicts and TestVloopLayoutFolders assert values

criteria.criterion: Owned commits from every local ref: latest plan, last run commit after it, task commits between; plan read via git
criteria.evidence: commits.go OwnedCommits uses log --all, ancestry-path; PlanAt uses git show; TestOwnedCommitsLatestPlanOnly (re-plan), ...AnyRefAndNoRunCommit, ...PlanReadFromGit

criteria.criterion: Nothing under .loop/ or .vloop/ is written; / separators, no case-sensitivity assumption
criteria.evidence: only reads in the code; path package and ToSlash used; test asserts .vloop is not created

criteria.criterion: Committed tests TestShellLoop…, TestVloopLayout…, TestOwnedCommits… build fixtures in temp dirs
criteria.evidence: runs_test.go uses t.TempDir fixtures and temp git repos with GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null; no repo .loop/home reads

notes: Minor: the 'plan session in another branch's folder' case is only exercised via ownership being independent of the group folder name (other-branch resuming folder), not a separate planning-from fixture. No absolute paths found.
